crossRefs.note: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”

translations.web: She said to her, “All that you say, I will do.”
translations.bsb: “I will do everything you say,” Ruth answered.
translations.kjv: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.
translations.asv: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest I will do.
